correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every infinite-dimensional step: \(T_a=\sum_{k\ge0}a_kR^k\) converges in operator norm; \(\|T_a\|=\|a\|_1\) is attained asymptotically by finite-coordinate phase matching; non-scalar kernels have no eigenvalues; every \(z\in\overline{\mathbb D}\) yields a nonzero functional \(F_z\) with \(F_zR=zF_z\); and the full \(\ell_1(\mathbb N_0)\) convolution algebra gives the reverse spectral inclusion. The scalar case and boundary \(|z|=1\) are handled separately.

value.rationale: The arbitrary \(\ell_1\)-kernel class is the natural norm-closed completion of the finite-band one-sided Toeplitz class. The theorem gives the complete fine spectral partition, not merely the ordinary spectrum, and shows that arbitrary infinite tails preserve pure residuality. This is a structural extension rather than a routine numerical or parameter increment.
